tools.name: list_mro_profiles
tools.description: List approved MR Optimum experiment profiles.

tools.name: list_mro_files
tools.description: List CloudMR-authorized MR Optimum files without exposing object-storage locations.

tools.name: select_mro_files
tools.description: Verify that selected signal and noise CloudMR file IDs are currently available to the shared agent. Does not submit a job.

tools.name: submit_brain_multislice_demo_ac_rss
tools.description: Queue one real Mode 2 AC/RSS test using the curated BrainMultiSlice signal/noise demo pair. Requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: inspect_mro_inputs
tools.description: Preflight registered inputs for an approved profile. Does not submit a job.

tools.name: plan_mro_run
tools.description: Create a reviewable MR Optimum run plan. Explicit user confirmation is required before submission.

tools.name: submit_mro_run
tools.description: Submit an explicitly confirmed, existing plan through CloudMR Brain.

tools.name: get_mro_run_status
tools.description: Get safe status for a CloudMR pipeline.

tools.name: diagnose_mro_run
tools.description: Return a redacted technical workflow diagnosis for a pipeline.

tools.name: get_mro_run_logs
tools.description: Retrieve a bounded, sanitized CloudWatch worker-log excerpt for one CloudMR pipeline. Read-only; does not submit, alter, or delete anything.

tools.name: get_mro_result_manifest
tools.description: Check whether an authorized completed run has outputs without exposing raw result URLs.
